# asc_volume (Data Source)

Reads a block volume from ASC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_volume" "example" {
  name = "example-data"
}

output "volume_size_bytes" {
  value = data.asc_volume.example.size_bytes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the volume, which identifies it in ASC.

### Read-Only

- `access_mode` (String) Access mode of the volume.
- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations ASC reports for the volume.
- `attached_to_vm` (String) Instance id of the virtual machine the volume is attached to, empty when it is detached. ASC reports the machine's uuid here, not its name.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels ASC reports for the volume.
- `last_error` (String) Last error reported by ASC, empty when there is none.
- `size` (String) Capacity as ASC spells it, for example "10Gi".
- `size_bytes` (Number) Capacity in bytes. ASC may spell an equal size differently between reads, so this is the value to compare against.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by ASC.
- `storage_class` (String) Storage class backing the volume.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the volume.
- `urn` (String) URN of the volume, which carries its uuid.
- `volume_mode` (String) Volume mode reported by ASC.
